name: IMDb

intro.Ads: IMDb's own Sponsored banners, video ads and the ad networks.
intro.Privacy: Trackers, permissions and the Braze marketing SDK.
intro.App: Prompts the app shows by itself, and signing in with Google without Google Play services.

summary: Remove the ads from the movie and TV database and stop its third-party trackers (comScore, Branch, Pinpoint, clickstream), without an account.

android.note: IMDb's minSdk is 30 (Android 11), and the x86_64 emulator needs arm64 translation, which google_apis images have from API 30 on (not API 33). The release tries the oldest supported version, the newest stable one and the next one; a pull request the oldest and the newest stable.

versions.phone_test: try browsing and a search on a phone: the emulator test only starts the app.
